content: Community lessons on homelab k8s over-engineering: going all-in on production tooling (full observability stacks, HA control planes, service mesh, self-hosted registries) turns the homelab into a second job ('free-time amateur DevOps keeping the platform healthy'). YAGNI is the repeated principle. k3s single-node is considered the sweet spot for learning real primitives without ops burden. Regretted items commonly cited: service mesh, multi-node HA on single physical host, self-hosted registry, heavyweight monitoring before apps exist.
